data.narrative:
WB Group is a pre-IPO-stage Defense & Security company founded by Piotr Wojciechowski, Adam Bartosiewicz, and Krzysztof Wysocki. The valuation analysis draws from a Defense & Security comp universe of 26 same-sector peers, comprising 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Standard peer-median triangulation is not applicable in this case. While 26 same-sector companies exist, filtering for stage-aligned or valuation-tier-aligned comparables yielded fewer than three datapoints across same-stage, adjacent-stage, and similar-tier buckets. A sector-wide median would introduce material noise given the heterogeneity in business model maturity, technology focus, and customer concentration within Defense & Security. The sparse narrow-set availability reflects both the fragmentation of the frontier-defense ecosystem and the limited number of pre-IPO benchmarks at comparable scale.

Without sufficient narrow-set coverage, this analysis cannot anchor to a triangulated valuation range with confidence. Proceeding would require either (1) expanding the comp set horizontally to adjacent defense subsectors or geographies, accepting reduced comparability, or (2) employing asset- or revenue-based methods if WB Group's financials permit. Key uncertainties include the target's revenue scale, customer concentration, technology differentiation versus the named private peers, and proximity to exit milestones. A credible valuation requires additional operational and financial detail not present in the current dataset.
